groups.coverage_change: Parent-origin isolation now tests both reads and writes. Newly covered external-resource refusal has its own network criterion. Existing eval probe is expanded to all five explicitly unsupported families; legitimate words in string/comment/HTML text get a successful control. Network blocking was not an old scored prerequisite.
Same four exact source fixtures at lines 4/6/2/2, each with an independent successful preview and ordinary recovery run.
Normal rename/title validation separated from stale-rename refusal/recovery. Adds required case-sensitive positive title pair and blank/whitespace-title refusal using current revisions.

In-app replacement warnings separated from native browser unload. In-app covers saved record, example, New and Import with cancel/accept and exact draft retention; native criterion owns its saved/dirty controls.

Independent download and import scores. Import adds no execution with Auto-run off, subsequent manual execution and path-like filename refusal alongside the existing unsupported-extension/server validation.

separate_clarification: Startup is explicitly useful auto-executed code, whether example or loaded snippet and whether the saved library is empty or not. The constraints gate may create one record before functional begins; no criterion deletes or assumes the absence of that record.

score_limit.meaning: Holding behavior fixed and assuming gates/floor already pass, the redistributed groups can expose at most this formerly all-or-nothing partial credit. The old sandbox bar was origin isolation AND eval refusal, not network blocking. The new network check adds a requirement: with old origin false and unsupported true, its largest group gain is 1.75+0.5=2.25, not 3. Other group gains are 3,1.5,1.25,2, totaling 10. Newly required negative probes can lower credit. This is not a measured model score or prediction; crossing the floor is discontinuous.
